rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site aggregated dataset; eleven datasets combined.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Eleven datasets were combined to create the full sample."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Public datasets include Cam-CAN, IXI, OASIS3, and NKI-Rockland (among others).
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "We included healthy participants from ten publicly available datasets: the Amsterdam Open MRI Collection (aomic) (id1000, piop1 and piop2) datasets, the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (camcan) dataset, the Dallas Longitudinal Brain Study (dlbs) dataset, the Information eXtraction from Images (ixi) dataset (http://braindevelopment.org/ixidataset/), the Narratives (narratives) dataset, the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (oasis3) dataset, the NKI-Rockland (rockland) dataset and the Southwest University adult lifespan (sald) dataset."

rci3_epd_name.detail: Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (camcan), Information eXtraction from Images (ixi), NKI-Rockland (rockland), and Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (oasis3).
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "We included healthy participants from ten publicly available datasets: the Amsterdam Open MRI Collection (aomic) (id1000, piop1 and piop2) datasets, the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (camcan) dataset, the Dallas Longitudinal Brain Study (dlbs) dataset, the Information eXtraction from Images (ixi) dataset (http://braindevelopment.org/ixidataset/), the Narratives (narratives) dataset, the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (oasis3) dataset, the NKI-Rockland (rockland) dataset and the Southwest University adult lifespan (sald) dataset."

rci5_n.detail: Training set of healthy participants across datasets; test set reported separately.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The training set included 4310 participants and the test set 859 participants."
